verses.1: A man may have a short-lived wife, or a wife who is very demanding.
verses.2: Like a bird that has flown away, it ran away, like a swallow, and it couldn’t be caught.
verses.3: Even then, you opened your eyes. And I will be brought before you in judgment.
verses.4: No one can be made pure from their impurities.
verses.5: If his days are numbered from the beginning of his new cycle, then you must do what is right, and not go against it.
verses.6: Let it be done at its appointed time, and let it cease when it is desired. As a hired worker’s day comes.
verses.7: For a tree has its own “cry” when it is cut down. It will still be replaced, and it will be revived again. It will not be destroyed completely.
verses.8: If he plants his roots in the earth, then his lineage will die in the sky.
verses.9: When it smells like water, it will bloom, and it will produce fruit just like a plant.
verses.10: And the days grew long, and people became weak and exhausted.
verses.11: Then the waters from the sea will be destroyed, and the rivers will also be destroyed.
verses.12: And those who lie down and do not get up until the end of the days, they will not rise from their graves. They will never be raised from their resting places.
verses.13: Who will give me the strength to endure your temptations and hide me from you until you finally decide to follow my laws and remember me?
verses.14: If the king dies, then all of the angels will live forever. They won’t stop until a new king comes to power.
verses.15: It shall be called, and I will answer you for your actions. Your deeds will be covered up.
verses.16: Now, my steps will no longer be marked by my sins.
verses.17: He was marked with the mark of sin, and he suffered greatly.
verses.18: But the Mount of Destruction will be destroyed, and its shape will be changed from its original form.
verses.19: Bricks that were made from water; their surfaces are covered with dirt and filth. The human heart is also destroyed.
verses.20: Let him be destroyed forever, and let his face be changed. Let him be sent away.
verses.21: They will protect their children, but they won’t understand. They will be troubled, but they won’t comprehend.
verses.22: But in his words, he suffers; and his soul is filled with sorrow.
